sample_unit: endoscopic images (60 missed gastric cancer lesions; 10 endoscopists)
models_evaluated: CADe deep learning system for early gastric cancer detection

links.outcome: Per-lesion sensitivity for missed gastric cancers, CADe versus 10 endoscopists on same images
links.effect: Per-lesion sensitivity 15.0% (9/60) for CADe vs 13.8% (83/600) for endoscopists (p = 0.538); per-image specificity 88.5% vs 94.8% (p < 0.001).
links.quote: The per-lesion sensitivity for MGCs was 15.0% (9/60) and 13.8% (83/600) for CADe and endoscopist detection, respectively (p = 0.538).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a deep-learning CADe system compared to 10 endoscopists in an offline reader study using retrospective endoscopic images.
